data.name: UnchartedRoad
data.detailed_description:
〓 Current Version: 0.1 - "Core Trial" 〓

In this initial stage, we focus on the purest combat loop, presenting you with its solid "soil":

  • Lock-On-Free Combat: Experience fluid, free-form combat from an over-the-shoulder perspective, where every dodge and attack feels immediate and visceral.

  • Skill Progression: Gain experience in battle to level up, unlock diverse skills, and choose your path of expertise.

  • Unique Skill Config: Chain basic skills into custom combos. The system currently offers 2 independent combo chains and 8 advanced skill slots for your strategic freedom.

  • Character Building: Use gathered resources to purchase powerful equipment or directly enhance your attributes, preparing for the next, greater challenge.

Please Note: The current version offers approximately 2-5 hours of core gameplay. This is not the whole journey—it is merely the first step.

〓 The Roadmap: An Untamed Wilderness 〓

The future of UnchartedRoad is one we will witness growing together. Our cultivation plan includes:

  • Deep Nurturing Systems: Expanding beyond the protagonist to introduce a companion system with its own independent development paths.

  • Strategy is Paramount: Emphasizing pre-battle preparation (skills, gear, items) and crucial in-the-moment tactical decisions to make every victory a testament to your wits.

  • Expanded Resource Management: Enriching the in-game economy and resource systems to give weight to every choice you make.

  • More Modes & World Expansion: Evolving beyond the current trials into broader, more diverse gameplay and worldscapes.

〓 A Gardener's Note 〓

I am Bionic, the lone gardener of these "wastes." This game is a seed—simple yet filled with immense potential for growth. The past years have been spent building a solid foundation of soil.

Now, the time for careful nurturing begins.

Thus, we sincerely invite players who are not deterred by the "Early Access" label and who find joy in witnessing a world grow from nothing. Your feedback and suggestions will be the most precious nourishment for this budding seed.

Welcome to the Bionic Atelier. Welcome to UnchartedRoad.

Let's watch it grow, together.
